note.note:
Consult Summary:
- Acute unilateral left elbow swelling with warmth; likely bursitis; septic arthritis unlikely at present; plan for bloods and follow-up.

History:
- Presenting complaint: Swelling of left elbow for about one week; not painful; mildly warm; possible intra-articular fluid; no clear injury.
- Associated/ROS: No trauma reported; patient able to move elbow normally. Describes skin in area as somewhat dry; no eczema observed.
- Past medical history: Osteoarthritis (previously diagnosed by GP a few years ago).
- Allergies: Peanut allergy.
- Medications: Not on regular medications.
- Social: Desk-based work; exercises by running 2–3 times per week.

Examination:
- Left elbow: swelling present; skin warm to touch; patient able to move elbow normally; no severe tenderness on palpation reported; skin around elbow dry.
- No signs of septic arthritis on exam (as assessed by clinician).

Impression:
- Working diagnosis: Left elbow bursitis.
- Septic arthritis considered but not currently suspected based on exam.

Plan:
- Treatment: Ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth twice daily after meals; discontinue if heartburn occurs.
- Investigations: Arrange blood tests to screen for inflammatory/infectious/rheumatologic causes and gout (inflammatory markers, infection screen, rheumatologic antibodies); forms will be mailed with instructions.
- Follow-up: Schedule follow-up appointment (in clinic or via video/phone) after blood tests are reviewed to assess joint and review results.
- Red flags: Seek urgent care if elbow becomes very red, very painful, or redness spreads rapidly.
- Communication: Patient may contact for a flexible follow-up modality; if symptoms worsen, a physical (in-person) appointment can be arranged.

Quality checks (document_quality):
- Missing but clinically expected elements: Vitals not documented; imaging not performed; full medication reconciliation beyond “no regular meds” documented; vaccination status not addressed.
- Internal conflicts: None detected.
- Transcript quality: Overall clear; minor conversational filler; no major inconsistencies.
